DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_DarkFlameFox:
While in party,
when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Burn, the enemy creates flames around itself, dealing continuous damage equal to <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> of the player's attack damage to enemies that come into contact with them. (Does not stack.)
Reduces own active skill cooldowns by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue2}%</>.
 Increases own damage when attacking burning enemies by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue2}%</>.
